name: nexus-enterprise
description: Enterprise-grade reference architecture: a single Create User use case implemented end-to-end with DDD, CQRS, Clean/Hexagonal Architecture, Dependency Injection (Awilix), OpenTelemetry tracing/metrics, and full test pyramid coverage. Fastify API + Next.js client + PostgreSQL.

scripts.clean: node -e "import('fs').then(fs => ['packages/application/dist', 'apps/api/dist','apps/web/.next','packages/infrastructure/dist', 'packages/domain/dist', 'packages/shared/dist', 'dist'].forEach(p => fs.rmSync(p, { recursive: true, force: true })));" && node -e "import('fs').then(fs => fs.readdirSync('.', { recursive: true }).filter(f => f.endsWith('.tsbuildinfo')).forEach(f => fs.rmSync(f, { force: true })));"
scripts.check:all: npm run format:check && npm run lint:check
scripts.fix:all: npm run format && npm run lint:fix
scripts.docker:up: npm run build && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.monitoring.yml up -d --build
scripts.docker:rebuild: npm run build && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.monitoring.yml up -d --build --force-recreate
scripts.db:setup: npm run docker:up && npm run migrate
scripts.dev:full: npm run format && npm run lint:fix && npm run build && npm run docker:up && npm run migrate && npm run test && npm run dev:api
scripts.k8s:redeploy: npx turbo run build && npx turbo run docker:build && npm run k8s:up && npm run k8s:restart:all
